milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The agent must navigate near the blue wool structure (center at approximately [5, 0, 5] relative to spawn) and face toward it, demonstrating they have visually located the blue wool. max_distance=5 ensures the agent actually approached the wool rather than just facing it from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is looking at the target.
